caseStudy.blurb: Agility's first cinematic brand film and the public debut of its refreshed visual identity.
caseStudy.team: Small core team across design, video production, and leadership
objectives: Introduce the refreshed identity at its highest-fidelity expression.
Set an art direction standard the rest of the brand could follow.
Serve both marketing and investor and partner audiences.
caseStudy.contribution: I designed on-screen graphics and gave brand direction feedback across edit rounds, keeping the new identity consistent from the first frame.
results: Debuted the refreshed identity to the public, investors, and partners.
Production decisions became the foundation of Agility's art direction guidelines.
Became the company's primary brand asset across marketing and investor contexts.
